title: DBFlux redesign: Accent color per theme (#987) · dark
brief: Issue #987, accent override scope: an Accent color row under Theme on a new Settings > Appearance page (the move accepted in #986), one value per theme with Reset on the row; the accent drives primary buttons, checked boxes, the progress bar, the text cursor, the selection, the focus ring and selected rows, with derived hover, pressed and text shades; syntax colors stay fixed.

artboards.title: Settings: new Appearance page, with the Accent color row under Theme
artboards.tradeoff: Appearance gets its own page right after General (theme, accent, density, language and the six font settings), so General stops mixing looks with startup and safety; one more page to scan in the sidebar.

artboards.title: Accent applied: surfaces, extremes and row states
artboards.tradeoff: Shows every surface the accent touches and the readability fallbacks at the extremes; dense, meant for review rather than as a screen.
